📲 Order on WhatsApp & How to Pay

Make your own order right here on this website — pick your items, then send the order straight to the shop.

  1. Select your items on this page, then tap “Send order on WhatsApp”. Your order opens in WhatsApp — press Send.
  2. The shop confirms your order on WhatsApp — the total bill and the delivery time.
  3. Pay the way the shop confirms. They will share their own payment details on WhatsApp (for example cash on delivery or a mobile payment). Only pay on the details the shop itself sends you in that chat — never pay anyone else.
  4. Send your payment screenshot / receipt on the same WhatsApp chat to confirm your payment, and keep the chat until your order arrives.
